about_the_game:
Welcome to Ravenwood Academy!

As a transfer student from Dragonspyre, fitting in at Ravenwood Academy sure hasn’t been easy. Staying on top of your classes and homework would be hard enough without everything else going on. There’s been some strange happenings around campus lately and you can’t help but feel that trouble is brewing around you ...


Investigate Strange Incidents

Search for clues and interview witnesses with your friends when chaos disrupts academic life. During your investigations you may find that things at Ravenwood may not always be what they seem.

Take a Stand

Overcome crises by combining clues and evidence to make persuasive arguments. You might be talking down a bully, arguing for extra credit with a Professor, or presenting a defense at a disciplinary hearing. Sometimes you’ll be saving a friend accused of misdeeds, while other times you might be trying to save your own hide!

Find Your Friends 

A cast of characters are eager to welcome you to Ravenwood Academy. You may be new and a bit of an outcast, but that doesn’t mean a few friendships aren’t ready to bloom! 

See a Different Side of the Spiral

Get a glimpse into Ravenwood Academy before the events of Wizard101. Meet and befriend familiar faces, discover untold backstories, and dive into the Spiral’s lore in a whole new way.

Want to see more of the Spiral? Check out Wizard101 & Pirate101!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: 2GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Integrated, requiring additional 1-2GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 14 GB available space

short_description: Step into the role of an outcast student wizard attending Ravenwood Academy and prepare to discover the truth behind the school’s bizarre events. Search for clues and solve mysteries in this story-book style puzzle game where things often aren't what they seem.
